children: New Delhi, Nov. 7 -- With the Diwali weekend here, moviegoers planning to watch the Ramayana movie in theatres can save on ticket bookings through several bank credit and debit card offers listed on BookMyShow. These include buy-one-get-one-free deals and instant discounts on eligible bookings.
Starring Ranbir Kapoor as Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita and Yash as Ravana, Nitesh Tiwari-directed Ramayana (Part 1) was released in theatres on November 5, ahead of Diwali on November 8.
Here is a look at the available BookMyShow offers across credit cards, debit cards, and Pay Later.

Among the popular bank offers, Axis Bank, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, SBI, HSBC and AU Bank provide buy-one-get-one-free deals or discounts on eligible credit cards. Some cards offer savings of up to Rs.840, while IDFC FIRST Bank Private Credit Card offers up to Rs.750 off on eligible bookings.
The additional processing fees apply to BookMyShow bookings. Further, several buy-one-get-one-free offers require customers to book at least two tickets in a single transaction.
Several banks also offer discounts on movie tickets through eligible debit cards.

Among debit card offers, AU Bank, Bandhan Bank, Axis Bank, IndusInd Bank, SBI, PNB and Union Bank of India have listed discounts or buy-one-get-one-free deals. Some eligible cards offer savings of up to Rs.500, while select YES Bank debit cards offer savings of up to Rs.840. Customers should check card-specific eligibility and discount limits before making a booking.
BookMyShow users paying through Amazon Pay Later can receive cashback ranging from Rs.20 to Rs.100 on a minimum transaction of Rs.399.

The offer is valid on web and app bookings until November 30, 2026, subject to limited availability. It is available once per user and cannot be combined with other offers. Cashback is credited to the user's Amazon Pay balance within 24 hours of the transaction.
Note: Offers are subject to card eligibility, transaction limits and individual bank terms. Check the applicable offer conditions on BookMyShow before booking.

title: Set to watch Ramayana movie on Diwali weekend? Check BookMyShow movie ticket offers on credit, debit cards, pay later
